changelog:
Motion detection looks at a fresh frame every 2 seconds again, so brief movement is no longer missed.
Editing a camera's name, policy or schedule no longer interrupts its recording.
Alerts and recordings are no longer lost while the recorder's database is busy, and pages stay responsive meanwhile.
An AI alert now ends even while the AI engine is failing.
Playback, the camera list, storage info and alert search load faster on recorders with a long history.
Timeline previews keep loading after the web app has sat idle.
Alerts that arrive while the web app is disconnected appear when it reconnects.
Adding a stream path no longer clears the camera form, and the device drawer lists only the current camera's zones.
The web app starts faster and downloads less.
Motion clips from H.265 cameras play on iPhones and Safari.
"Local account" in the account menu now shows only for sign-ins made on the recorder itself.
An offline camera logs one clear line instead of flooding the log.
On Windows, large disks leave room for the database next to the recordings.
